item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las tshogs bsags mar me'i shog chung
item.coloph: de ltar dgongs pa kun 'dus pa/ 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi/ tshogs bsags mar me'i shog chung 'di/ gten chen nyid kyis bkas bskul bzhin/ rdzogs chen ring lugs tha shal ba/ g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags pas/ rang gi khyad chas gang dran ltar/ bris 'dis 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog/
